name: Two-column comparison with examples
purpose: To compare two parallel workstreams or categories, each supported by a visual example and a list of detailed activities.
use_when: When you need to contrast two distinct processes or deliverables that both require a visual aid and a supporting list of bullet points.
avoid_when: When there is only one main topic or when the content requires a complex data chart instead of a simple screenshot/diagram.
notes: The layout includes specific 'Beispiel' (Example) labels over the image areas that should be maintained or updated.
